data.name: Balloonatics
data.detailed_description:
VR and Non-VR Cross-Play

Built from the ground up for both VR and Non-VR. We don’t discriminate. Controller support too!

Invite your Friends or Fly Solo

Have up to 6 players in a party. Play against bots, party members, or other players online.

Weapons

Collect a range of both useful and ridiculous weapons including a box of bees and bird blades. Enjoy an unlimited amount of trusty spike balls!

Abilities

Character abilities will help you take down enemies. Dash across the map, fire a homing missile, or freeze players in place.

Danger!

Flash storms? Burning sun rays? Falling lava rocks? No problem.

Solo Challenges

Test yourself with challenges to improve those shooting and driving skills!

reviews.review:
Alright, Where to begin. This game has tons of promise! They have made many improvements in the past few months and the game has gone from a slow paced item hoarding game to a fast paced race around the map to get weapons before your enemy's do! You will find your self panicking a lot when you hear all the different sounds like your engine dieing or a mine sitting beside you, or the damn bees!!! Ohh the bees!!!

The games graphics are awesome and it runs smooth as unsalted butter :P People will love being able to play this with friends, regardless if you or your buddy's are playing in VR or not. This game is for everyone. For us old timers it brings back a lot of memories of playing balloon battles in Mario Cart Battle mode!
 
This game is gonna become popular for sure, has a lot of potential for E-Sports game play as well. I say buy this game just for the sake of having it! you wont be sorry.

One of the best parts about this game right now is that its in Early Access and so that means its gonna change a lot based on what the community wants and asks for! They are bug hunting all hours of the day to try and tie up any loose ends the game might have. 

Pros:

* Super fun - You will find your self chasing and trying to cause your friends all sorts of issues wile they try and collect weapons and boost! 
* Fast Paced Game play - There is no time to sit and collect your thoughts. No time to sit and enjoy the super cool looking maps. Keep your eyes peeled and your basket moving!
* Great Soundtrack - The music for the levels and when your in battle is just awesome! gets you going a little faster at some point. keeps the pressure on! (looking forward to Overtime music!)
* Cool Weapons - There are about 6-8 weapon types right now that are kick ass! They are all custom made graphics with awesome sound effects! They also can all be added to the slingshot and fired at people! Weapons become AMMO!!!  
* Awesome Graphics and Performance - This game runs super smooth. We have done a lot of 6 player free for all battles and there has been no issues with FPS or lag so far! (This could chance the more popular the game gets)
* The Characters - You wont stop laughing at some of these characters they have added to the game! They are gonna add more at some point as well with a lot of customizations too! 

Cons:

* Not enough players - Due to it being Early access and just being release 02/13/18
* Not enough weapons - Again due to it being early access but the devs have plans to launch a lot more weapons as the development process goes on.
* Not enough Maps - Only 3 maps but they are well detailed. Devs have plans for more maps also.
* Advantage Non-VR - Very small advantage for Non-VR players when it comes to tossing stuff outa your basket with your hands. Non VR players have the ability to charge up a hand throw but the VR players do not! So VR players kinda gota get used to tossing stuff like 1-2 feet behind your basket and run away! (Devs know about this and have plans to fix it)
